meta.title: Selekoa historical research sample
meta.scope: Selected historical records, 1965–2024, plus prior roles with unknown dates. Genesis source checks are dated 2026-09-17; personnel-continuity checks are dated 2026-09-18. Human source review pending. Not a current or comprehensive sector inventory. Governance version histories through July 2026, researched September 18, 2026; policy text is not evidence of implementation. Selected capital and compute records through April 2026; transaction stages do not imply current arrangements or realised spending. Targeted corrections dated 2026-09-25: one attributed claim accepted after explicit human source review; a second narrowly scoped résumé passage is human-reviewed. Other seed claims remain pending. Intellectual Lineage II adds selected oversight citations and agenda reception, checked 2026-09-25; all new records remain pending human review. Evaluation Institutions I adds bounded institutional and documentary records, checked 2026-09-27; new claims remain seeds, not editorially accepted. Evaluation Ontology I adds four scoped engagement and institutional announcement seeds, checked 2026-09-28; no human acceptance or legal succession inferred. Schema 2.7 records each source's language; the frontier safety framework sources also record the nearest existing Internet Archive capture, checked 2026-10-03. A capture shows only what the archive held on its date and does not authenticate earlier bytes.
